department: Program in Materials Science and Engineering

deadline.value: January 6, 2027 at 11:59PM PST deadline for PhD applications
deadline.quote: *the Fall 2027 Applications DEADLINE (PhD & MS) will be: Wednesday, January 06 2027 (01/06/27) 11:59PM PST

gre_general.value: GRE scores are not required for PhD applications.
gre_general.quote: the Program in Materials Science and Engineering (MATS) does not require GRE scores for the MS and PhD applications.

gre_subject.value: ETS offers no Materials Science subject test.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Pre-application supervisor requirement is not stated.

funding.value: First-year PhD financial support package includes minimum $37,500 commitment plus tuition, mandatory fees, and non-resident supplemental tuition.
funding.quote: At UC San Diego, the general financial support package for first-year Ph.D. students includes a minimum commitment of $37,500 plus tuition and mandatory fees. If you are not a California resident, the non-resident supplemental tuition will also be covered.

entry_route.value: Successful applicants must hold a bachelor's degree or equivalent with at least 3.0 GPA.
entry_route.quote: Successful applicants must hold a bachelor's degree or the equivalent from an accredited institution in the United States or from a recognized university-level academic institution abroad and at least a B average (3.0 GPA) or its equivalent by the time they enroll.
